title: A surface feature: a school, a big fish, a curious spot or a disturbance (R14)

name.description: As it reads in the log: 'a school of roach'.

kind.description: How it looks on the water.

radius.description: How close to its centre the bobber must land, in scene pixels.

uses.description: How many casts into it before it's fished out (R14.3).

lifetime.description: How many casts it stays, if not fished out first.

swimsOff.description: How many times its fish can get away and the feature swims off elsewhere with the same fish, before it goes for good (D85).

drift.description: How far it may drift with each cast, in scene pixels.

effects.description: Game value changes for a cast that lands in it.

fish.description: For a cast that lands in it, the fish table instead of the location's.

junk.description: For a cast that lands in it, the junk table instead of the location's.

minBand.description: A fish from it is at least this size band (an id from content/rules/size-bands.json).
